name: Little Red Barn Campground
note: Family-run wooded campground open mid-April through October, with a large seasonal contingent: about half the pads held trailers in Feb 2020 off-season imagery. Reservations by request form, confirmed by the office. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site (littleredbarncampground.com, read 2026-10-21; rates page modified 2026-03-02): published nightly RV rates for W/E 30/50-amp sites plus 7-night and monthly rates, seasonal 'please call', reservation request form taking motorhomes/travel trailers/fifth wheels with no length cap stated, no standing minimum outside holiday weekends; operator site map shows ~93 numbered RV sites plus ~43 basic sites and 6 field sites; season April 11 - October 31 (events calendar), so not residential; no homes or lots sold; Google Maps 4.4 from 254 reviews. Different park from Tohickon Family Campground (~1 km WSW, different address/owner/map). Price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: operator site map (2018 map, posted 2022) shows no water on the property, and its fishing derby is held at an 'off site' pond. Esri World_Imagery (WV03 2025-09-20) at +/-350 m and +/-220 m around the site loops, plus Wayback 2020-02-03 leaf-off: wooded loops, pool and pavilion, no stream, pond or lake in frame. Tohickon Creek runs ~1 km WSW past the neighbouring Tohickon Family Campground, out of sight and reach. Default down: not waterfront.
fees_source: https://littleredbarncampground.com/rates/camping-rates/ (page modified 2026-03-02, read 2026-10-21): RV Campsites W/E 30 amp $60.00 standard / $67.00 holiday weekends; W/E 50 amp $65.00 / $72.00; 7-night $408/$443; monthly $953/$1010. Basic no-hookup sites are listed only in the tent table ($47). Additional adults $10, children $5; no resort or grounds fee. Not quoted through an engine: reservations are by request form only.

booking.note: Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends need 3 nights, paid in full; holiday sites still open a week out are sold for shorter stays. The October Halloween weekends need 2 nights.

booking_source: https://littleredbarncampground.com/rates/reservation-request/ (read 2026-10-21): 'Holiday weekends include: Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day - 3 night minimum ... Any sites not reserved 1 week prior to holiday will be made available for less than 3 night stay'; 'Two-night minimum for these Halloween weekends'. Events calendar (home page, 2026) repeats the 3-night holiday and 2-night Halloween minimums.
flags: 10% military discount (active, Guard, Reserve, retired) on the operator Specials page; not written to discounts here.

Seasonal share not counted: no source splits seasonal from nightly sites. About 60-70 trailers sat on ~140 pads in Feb 2020, when the park was closed, so roughly half are seasonal or stored. Nightly share looks well over 1 in 10.

Booking is by web request form plus an office call/email to confirm and take a deposit. There is no instant online engine, so the rate is read only from the published table (dated by the page's 2026-03-02 modification).
